title: Answer: no account of time, which is one of the scales a causal model is coarse-grained along

statements.text: Causal emergence takes no position on what time is. Time is one of the axes along which a system's causal structure is described: the micro causal model is the most fine-grained representation in space and time, and a macroscale can be a mapping in space, in time, or both, such as grouping micro steps into one macro step. Which temporal scale carries the most causal power is a question about each system, answered by measuring effective information.
statements.scope: the 2016 paper When the map is better than the territory

sources.quote: The causal structure of any system can be analyzed at a multitude of spatial and temporal scales.
A macroscale can be a mapping in space, time, or both.
